name: Voxel Center Generation from Bounding Box
definition: Fills a bounding box with voxel center points. It iterates through the dimensions of the bounding box adjusted to voxel size to generate a list of 3D points representing voxel centers.
summary: Voxel Center Generation from Bounding Box creates a 6-connected grid of sample points from an axis-aligned box and voxel size, differing from index-based methods by accepting direct spatial parameters.
